shellCommands.command: ls -la && git ls-files && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -c 400 package-lock.json
cat index.html src/*.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls -R __agent_eval__ | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat package.json | grep '"version"'; ls build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -n "variant\|color" build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "size\|view\|href\|width" build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && grep -o "'[a-z0-9-]*'" Text/text/text.js | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -n "color" Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head; ls layout; grep -n "type\|view" Card/Card.d.ts | head -20; grep -rn "ButtonView =\|ButtonSize =" Button/*.d.ts

sed -n 1,80p layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | grep -n "gap\|direction\|alignItems\|justify\|wrap\|grow\|basis" ; grep -o "'[a-z-]*'" Text/colorText/colorText.js | tr '\n' ' '; grep -n "as\b\|as?" Text/Text.d.ts
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -i 's/<html lang="en">/<html lang="ru">/; s#<title>Gravity UI eval</title>#<title>Ритм — учёт времени команды</title>#' index.html && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15
